meta.name: git-master
meta.description: MUST USE for ANY git operations. Atomic commits, rebase/squash, history search (blame, bisect, log -S). STRONGLY RECOMMENDED: Use with task(category='quick', load_skills=['git-master'], ...) to save context. Triggers: 'commit', 'rebase', 'squash', 'who wrote', 'when was X added', 'find the commit that'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 执行 git 提交、整理提交记录与搜索历史
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果管理代码提交、整理提交记录或追溯历史修改是你的日常。
copy.tagline_en: Commit code, organize commit history, and search past changes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often commit code, organize commit history, or search past changes.

howto.what: 它会替你在仓库里执行 git 操作:把改动拆成多个原子提交、按依赖顺序排列、用 rebase/squash 整理历史,也能查出某处改动是哪次提交引入的。改动 3 个以上文件时,它被要求拆成多次提交。
howto.when: 当你提到 commit、rebase、squash 等词,或要查某次改动何时加入时触发;原文写明任何 git 操作都必须用它,且要先判断模式,不能默认走提交流程。

say.text: 帮我把这些改动提交,按仓库风格拆成原子提交
say.note: 会先输出风格检测和提交计划

say.text: 把这个分支最近 3 次提交 squash 成一个
查一下这行代码是谁写的、什么时候加的

howto.what_en: It runs git work in your repo's existing style: splits changes into multiple atomic commits, orders them by dependency, does rebase/squash cleanup, and finds which commit added a change. 3+ changed files forces multiple commits.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention commit, rebase, or squash, or ask when a change was added. The description says it must be used for any git operation, after mode detection.

say_en.text: Commit my changes, split into atomic commits matching this repo's style
say_en.note: Prints style detection and a commit plan first

say_en.text: Squash the last 3 commits on this branch into one
Find who wrote this line and when it was added
